findings.title: AppArmor profile is not loaded on the node
findings.cause: the pod asks for AppArmor profile Localhost k8s-kd-faults-hardened, and node kd-faults-control-plane cannot enforce it, so the kubelet rejects the pod: Pod was rejected: Cannot enforce AppArmor: AppArmor is not enabled on the host

evidence.what: pod status is Failed, reason AppArmor
evidence.detail: Pod was rejected: Cannot enforce AppArmor: AppArmor is not enabled on the host

evidence.what: the pod's and the container's appArmorProfile

findings.fix: Load the profile on every node that may run the pod (apparmor_parser, from a DaemonSet or the Security Profiles Operator), keep the pod to the nodes that have it, or use appArmorProfile type RuntimeDefault. A node without AppArmor (not enabled in its kernel) can run the pod only without a profile.
